growth_signal.value: Systems are deployed by six European armed forces, and it opened Europe's largest production facility for military robotic systems.

raised.note: confirmed by two sources in the run; the URLs were not saved
raised.value: €42M Series A total (€31M plus an €11M extension)

entry.idea: ARX Robotics builds unmanned ground vehicles and AI software that let armed forces send robots instead of people into dangerous jobs like reconnaissance and logistics.
entry.lesson: In defense, selling the software that upgrades old equipment can open the door as wide as selling new hardware.
entry.name: ARX Robotics

growth.reason: Being deployed by six European armed forces and opening Europe's largest production facility for this category is a concrete scale signal.

market.reason: European defense budgets are rising fast, but this market is mostly limited to military buyers in a handful of countries.

tech.reason: Building rugged autonomous ground vehicles plus software that retrofits older military vehicles is hard, specialised engineering.

entry.twist: Its Mithra OS software can also upgrade existing older military vehicles with autonomy, not just its own new robots.
entry.who_pays: European armed forces and defense ministries pay to buy and deploy the robotic vehicles and software.
entry.why_now: European militaries are investing heavily in defense technology and want to reduce risk to soldiers using autonomous ground vehicles.
